description: This file defines command-line test commands for the Mattermost server, including web client tests and server setup, using Cobra CLI framework. It includes functions to initialize, run, and manage test execution and server configuration.

methods.name: webClientTestsCmdF
methods.description: Executes web client tests by initializing server, translations, and APIs, then running tests.

methods.name: serverForWebClientTestsCmdF
methods.description: Sets up server for web client tests, handles signals for graceful shutdown.

methods.name: setupClientTests
methods.description: Configures server settings for testing environment.

methods.name: executeTestCommand
methods.description: Runs an external command, captures and prints its output, handles errors.

methods.name: runWebClientTests
methods.description: Changes directory and executes npm test command for web client testing.
